The Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Limited has released the RVUNL Final Result 2026 on 22nd June 2026 at its official website energy.rajasthan.gov.in. Candidates who appeared for the mains examination (Technician III, Operator III, and Plant Attendant III posts) held on 23th February can now check their qualifying status, download mains merit list PDF. Also, in order to download the RVUNL Mains Scorecard 2026, candidate need to login using the Roll Number and Date of Birth. Scroll down to get complete information related to the RVUNL JVVNL Result 2026.

RVUNL Result 2026 Out

राजस्थान राज्य के विद्युत निगमों ने टेक्नीशियन III, ऑपरेटर III और प्लांट अटेंडेंट III (आईटीआई) के कुल 2163 पदों के लिए आयोजित मुख्य परीक्षा 23 फरवरी का परिणाम जारी कर दिया है, जिसे अभ्यर्थी आधिकारिक वेबसाइट पर जाकर देख सकते हैं। इससे पहले प्रारम्भिक परीक्षा 24 से 27 नवम्बर तक आयोजित की गई थी, जिसके आधार पर लगभग दस गुना उम्मीदवारों को मुख्य परीक्षा के लिए चुना गया था, जिसमें कुल 23,789 अभ्यर्थियों ने भाग लिया। RVUNL Mains Result 2026 को 22 जून 2026 को जारी कर दिया गया है, जिससे भर्ती प्रक्रिया में तेजी आई है। मुख्य परीक्षा में सफल कुल 4673 अभ्यर्थियों को दस्तावेज सत्यापन के लिए शॉर्टलिस्ट किया गया है, जो 1 अप्रैल से 17 अप्रैल 2026 तक चम्बल रेस्ट हाउस, हवा सड़क, सोडाला, जयपुर में आयोजित होगा। शॉर्टलिस्ट अभ्यर्थियों को ईमेल और एसएमएस के माध्यम से सूचना भेजी जा रही है और वे अपना कॉल लेटर वेबसाइट से डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं।

RVUNL Final Result 2026 Merit List PDF Download

The RVUNL Mains Result 2026 Merit List PDF has been released along with the result on the official website, allowing candidates to check their selection status for the next stage. The merit list contains the roll numbers of shortlisted candidates who have qualified based on their performance. Candidates can download the PDF and use the search option to quickly locate their roll number. The direct link to download the RVUNL Result 2026 PDF shared below.

Steps to Check the RVUNL Final Result 2026

Step 1: Visit the official website of राजस्थान राज्य विद्युत उत्पादन निगम लिमिटेड (Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Limited): energy.rajasthan.gov.in.

Step 2: Go to the “Careers Section”, followed to “New Recruitment”

Step 3: Click on the link for “RVUNL Mains Result (Technician III, Operator III, and Plant Attendant III)”

Step 4: Enter your Roll Number and password/date of birth

Step 5: Click on the submit button

Step 6: View your result and download the scorecard

Check JVVNL Technical Helper Cut Off 2026

RVUNL JVVNL Final Scorecard 2026 PDF Link

The RVUNL JVVNL Mains Scorecard 2026 PDF link has been activated on the official website, enabling candidates to check their individual marks and performance in the mains examination. Candidates can access the scorecard by logging in with their registration credentials on the official portal @energy.rajasthan.gov.in. The scorecard provides detailed information such as marks obtained, qualifying status, and candidate details, making it an essential document for the upcoming document verification stage.

Check JVVNL Technicial Helper Result 2026

RVUNL Final Result 2026: Number of Candidates Shortlisted

As per the RVUNL Result 2026, a total of 4673 candidates have been shortlisted for the document verification stage. The Group I has the highest number of shortlisted candidates with 4498. In comparison, Group II has 63 candidates, Group III has 51 candidates, and Group IV has 61 candidates.

Group Number of Candidates Shortlisted
Group I 4498
Group II 63

Group IV 61
Total 4673

What After RVUNL Final Result 2026

After the declaration of the RVUNL Mains Result 2026, shortlisted candidates will move to the next stage of the recruitment process, which is document verification.

  • During this stage, candidates must present their original documents to confirm their eligibility, qualifications, and category details.
  • Those who successfully complete the verification process will be considered for final selection, after which the final merit list will be released and appointment letters will be issued accordingly.

RVUNL JVVNL Document Verification Call Letter 2026

Along with the mains result, the RVUNL has also uploaded the document verification call letter for the candidates shortlisted in the mains examination. Candidates can download their call letter from the official website by logging in with their registration credentials. It is mandatory to carry the printed call letter along with original documents to the verification center. Additionally, shortlisted candidates are also being informed through SMS and email regarding their DV schedule.

FAQs Regarding the RVUNL Result 2026

Ques 1. When was the RVUNL Final Result 2026 declared?

Ans: The RVUNL Mains Result 2026 was declared in 22nd June 2026 at the official website.

Ques 2. How many vacancies are there in RVUNL Recruitment 2026?

Ans: The recruitment drive is being conducted for a total of 2163 posts of Technician-III, Operator-III, and Plant Attendant-III.

Ques 3. How many candidates qualified in the RVUNL Mains Result 2026?

Ans: A total of 4673 candidates have been shortlisted for the document verification stage.

Ques 4. What is the next stage after RVUNL Mains Result 2026?

Ans: The next stage is document verification, which will be conducted from 1 April to 17 April 2026 in Jaipur.

Ques 5. How will candidates receive RVUNL DV updates?

Ans: Shortlisted candidates will receive updates through the official website, along with SMS and email notifications regarding their document verification schedule.
